decisive_items: Positive myositis panel for anti-SAE antibodies
Skin biopsy results were consistent with Wong-type presentation
response.rationale: The heliotrope rash, proximal muscle weakness, elevated creatine kinase, anti-SAE myositis antibodies, and Wong-type skin biopsy are defining features of dermatomyositis. The other candidates rely on nonspecific history, serology, or imaging findings and do not account for this constellation.

rejected.why: CT opacities and RA history do not explain the heliotrope rash, muscle weakness, muscle enzymes, anti-SAE antibodies, or Wong-type biopsy.
Hepatitis history and transaminitis are not enough for autoimmune hepatitis and do not explain the myositis, rash, or biopsy findings.
Anti-SSA positivity can be an overlap serology and does not establish Sjögren syndrome in the absence of characteristic sicca features.
